signatures.description: Verifying SIGTERM crash-logging in a spawned node child: the child exited 0 but wrote no shutdown record. Cause: Node drops a self-sent signal when the event loop is empty at delivery - signal callbacks are queued as loop events, so a process with nothing pending exits first. Repro/fix for tests: give the stub server a keep-alive (setTimeout(() => {}, 300) in the stub server.js) or any open handle; real servers hold a listening socket so production is unaffected. Do not treat the missing record as a broken handler.
